proof.criterion: Mechanism choice: GitHub's cache-mode cannot be keyed on the ref
proof.surface: GitHub Actions in sjawhar/legion: throwaway branch probe/infra-584-cache-mode (deleted; the runs remain)
proof.command: push workflows with cache-mode: ${{ github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && 'write' || 'read' }} (workflow level), ${{ startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/heads/probe/') && 'write' || 'read' }} (job level), ${{ needs.mode.outputs.mode }} and ${{ vars.X || 'read' }}; read each run's annotations
proof.observed: Runs 40445439022, 40445440160, 40445585659 and 40445586575 were refused as invalid workflow files: `Unrecognized named-value: 'github'` (also 'needs' and 'vars'). So Arm B, per-step gating, was taken.
proof.negativeControl: Repository precedent: a literal `cache-mode: none` is accepted on every credentialed release job (release.yaml), so the refusal comes from the context in the expression, not from the key.

trickyParts: actions/cache/save needs the identical path block as its restore; the save key is the restore's cache-primary-key output, gated on github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && cache-hit != 'true'.

restore-keys is an expression that gives the prefix off main and an empty string on main. A run on main seeded from an older entry would save a module cache that only grows (the module cache is never pruned).
The notices paths filter runs only on pull_request. On a push or merge_group its output is empty, so the step's condition `github.event_name != 'pull_request' || …` always runs it.
Worker image cache-to is an expression that is empty off main. BuildKit's gha exporter fails a build that cannot write, so the flag must be absent there.
deviations: Plan Arm B moved setup-go's folders aside; implemented instead as setup-go `cache: false` plus an actions/cache/restore/save pair, because setup-go's post step writes core.warning('There are no cache folders on the disk') on every PR job when the folders are gone. New key families go-daemon-, go-envoy-, go-envoy-infra-, go-docs-: the Go module cache is cold on PRs until the first main run after the merge writes them.
The notices filter also lists .github/workflows/pr-and-main.yaml (the step's own body), so this PR runs the step; the skip is proven by scratch #2329.

Spec departure 3 (plan) taken: off main, setup-bun is not restored (no-cache), because its only cache input also stops the restore. The cost is about 2 s per job (Setup Bun 0.03 min median, before and after).
